_note: Mechanics only, written for this app: no rules text and no text from the campaign book. Card codes are MarvelCDB codes for pack 'mts'. The campaign pool is a card list, because that is what the rulebook calls it and what it holds; the two recorded facts that are not cards are flags, read with countTrue because the engine files a flag under the scenario that set it.

notice.fr:
Campagne non officielle, reconstituée pour l'application : le livret et les cartes de la boîte L'Ombre du Titan Fou restent nécessaires pour jouer.

L'application fait pour vous les tirages que la campagne laisse au hasard et tient le registre : les Pierres d'Infinité obtenues, ce qui est passé dans votre pile de victoire, et en campagne experte les points de vie de chaque héros entre les parties.
notice.en:
Unofficial, reconstructed for the app: the rulebook and cards from The Mad Titan's Shadow box are still needed to play.

The app makes the campaign's random draws for you and keeps the log: the Infinity Stones earned, what went into your victory display, and in an expert campaign each hero's hit points between games.
